GraphQL schema scope.D-01: v1-essential Thing type only — name, year, players, playtime, min_age, image, thumbnail, description, average, bayes_average, users_rated, average_weight, is_expansion, owners. Skip polls, comments, versions, expansions, categories, mechanics, designers, etc. Add in v2. [NEEDS ADR: ADR-003]
GraphQL schema scope.D-02: mergedCollection(usernames: [String!]!): MergedCollection! — server-side merge via BggThing.merged_for_users scope. One DB query, deduped things with owner arrays.
GraphQL schema scope.D-03: Individual columns on bgg_things for statistics: average, bayes_average, users_rated, average_weight, num_comments. Clean, queryable, indexable. Migration needed.
GraphQL schema scope.D-04: Skip thing detail queries (thing(id), things(ids)). Game cards link to BGG (COLL-12). Smaller schema.
GraphQL schema scope.D-05: Minimal User type: username + avatar only. Full profile is v2.
GraphQL schema scope.D-06: Two mutations with dry-validation contracts: importCollection(username: String!): ImportResult and validateBggUsername(username: String!): ValidationResult. Start contract-first pattern in Phase 3, Phase 4 inherits. [NEEDS ADR: ADR-004]
GraphQL schema scope.D-07: Dedicated HotItemType (id, name, thumbnail, rank, yearPublished) and SearchResultType (id, name, yearPublished) — only fields BGG actually returns for each endpoint. Accurate field availability.
GraphQL schema scope.D-08: MergedCollection wrapper type: { items: [MergedThing!]!, syncStatuses: [UserSyncStatus!]! }. MergedThing = Thing fields + owners: [Owner!]!. UserSyncStatus = { username, status (READY|SYNCING|QUEUED|ERROR), lastSyncedAt, error }. Frontend gets games + per-user sync state in one query. [NEEDS ADR: ADR-005]

Collection import UX flow.D-09: Auto-import on submit: user enters usernames → inline validation → importCollection mutation fires automatically for each valid user → frontend subscribes to sync status → shows skeleton loaders with per-user status → full collection renders when ready. Stale cached data shown immediately (stale-while-revalidate). [NEEDS ADR: ADR-006]
Collection import UX flow.D-10: Per-user status cards in sidebar: colored badges (yellow Syncing, green Ready, red Failed) with game count. Game grid shows partial results from ready users while others sync. Per-user retry button on error.
Collection import UX flow.D-11: GraphQL subscriptions for real-time sync status (no polling). Solid Cable (DB-backed, no Redis) + graphql-ruby Subscriptions. SubscriptionType with collectionSynced(username: String!): SyncStatus!. ImportCollectionJob broadcasts status changes. Frontend uses useSubscription. [NEEDS ADR: ADR-007]
Collection import UX flow.D-12: Manual refresh: per-user 'Refresh' button with 15-min cooldown (disabled with countdown timer if too recent). Stale-while-revalidate: old data shown while refreshing.
Collection import UX flow.D-13: ADRs in docs/adr/ with MADR format (Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives). CONTEXT.md references them as canonical refs. Planner/executor creates them during execution. Meta-decision: most interesting decisions get ADRs.

Permalink & URL state.D-14: Real-time history.replaceState — URL updates silently on every filter/search/sort/grouping/owner-toggle change. Address bar always reflects current state. No explicit Share button needed.
Permalink & URL state.D-15: Owner filter encoded in URL — &owners=alice,bob for toggled-on owners. Full fidelity replay of sender's view.
Permalink & URL state.D-16: Omit default/empty values from URL — only non-default values appear. Shorter, readable permalinks: /collection?usernames=alice,bob&players=4&sort=rating.
Permalink & URL state.D-17: No legacy /u/:usernames compat — only /collection?usernames= format. Clean break from v1.

Layout & navigation.D-18: Three routes: / (landing/hero with username input), /collection (main merged view with permalink state), /hot (hot games). Search is a panel inside /collection, not a separate route.
Layout & navigation.D-19: Sidebar + topbar layout. Left sidebar: user list with sync status badges, owner toggles, refresh buttons. Main content: game grid. Top bar: app name, nav links, username input. Sidebar collapses to drawer on mobile.
Layout & navigation.D-20: md breakpoint (768px) — sidebar visible on md+ (≥768px), collapses to slide-out drawer with hamburger toggle on mobile (<768px). Standard Tailwind breakpoint.
Layout & navigation.D-21: Auto-fill grid with minmax(180px, 1fr) — cards size to fit, ~4-6 columns on desktop, 2 on mobile. Dense, efficient. Matches reference app pattern.

deferred_ideas: HTTP QUERY method (draft-ietf-httpbis-safe-method-w-body) — no browser support, can't use for permalinks, Apollo doesn't support it, URI length not a constraint. Revisit if adopted.
Server-side search (Postgres pg_trgm/FTS) — Fuse.js client-side breaks >300 games. Fine for v1. Move to v2.
Thing detail pages — game cards link to BGG instead. v2 if in-app pages wanted.
Legacy /u/:usernames permalink compat — clean break from v1. No users to migrate.
